stem: The function \(f\) is linear, and \(f(3x) = 3f(x) - 8\) for all values of \(x\). If \(f(2) = 10\), what is the value of \(f(5)\)?
solution: Let \(f(x) = mx + b\). Then \(f(3x) = 3mx + b\) and \(3f(x) - 8 = 3mx + 3b - 8\).
These are equal for all \(x\), so \(b = 3b - 8\), which gives \(b = 4\).
verify:
x, m, b = symbols('x m b')
f = lambda u: m*u + b
eqs = Poly(expand(f(3*x) - (3*f(x) - 8)), x).all_coeffs() + [f(2) - 10]
sol = solve(eqs, [m, b], dict=True)
assert sol == [{m: 3, b: 4}]
ans = f(5).subs(sol[0])
assert ans == 19 and spr_answers == [str(ans)]
